{'text': 'Apple 首款可摺疊 iPhone 預計將於兩星期多後公布。儘管可能會以「iPhone Ultra」作為品牌名稱，定價亦超過 2,000 美元，但佢會有多項重大限制。', 'target': "Apple's first foldable iPhone is expected to be unveiled in just over two weeks. Despite potentially being branded as the 'iPhone Ultra' and carrying a price tag of over $2,000, it will come with several significant compromises."}

{'text': '#1：遠攝鏡頭', 'target': '#1: Telephoto Camera'}

{'text': '據報 iPhone Ultra 將配備兩個鏡頭，包括主鏡頭與超廣角鏡頭，預計不會配備遠攝鏡頭。對許多人嚟講，這可能係呢部裝置設計上最大嘅限制。', 'target': "The iPhone Ultra is reportedly going to feature just two lenses, including a main and ultra-wide camera, with no telephoto lens expected. For many, this may be the biggest compromise in the device's design."}

{'text': 'iPhone Ultra 嘅主鏡頭同超廣角鏡頭預計均為 4,800 萬像素，與現時基本型號嘅 iPhone 17 類似。', 'target': "The iPhone Ultra's main and ultra-wide cameras are both expected to be 48-megapixels, similar to the current base iPhone 17."}

{'text': '#2：動作按鈕', 'target': '#2: Action Button'}

{'text': '根據多個流出嘅 iPhone Ultra 模型機顯示，該裝置將唔配備動作按鈕。事實上，佢似乎將會係 Apple 首款冇任何靜音開關嘅 iPhone。', 'target': 'Based on multiple leaked iPhone Ultra dummy units, the device will not feature an Action Button. In fact, it appears to be the first iPhone from Apple without any mute switch.'}

{'text': '模型機顯示裝置嘅左側邊緣完全係空嘅。據報側邊按鈕同相機控制按鈕將設於 iPhone Ultra 嘅右側邊緣，而音量按鈕則會設於裝置嘅頂部邊緣，類似 iPad mini 嘅設計。', 'target': 'The dummy units show the left edge of the device completely empty. The side button and Camera Control button are reportedly located on the right edge of the iPhone Ultra, while the volume buttons are on the top edge, similar to the iPad mini.'}

{'text': '#3：Face ID', 'target': '#3: Face ID'}

{'text': 'iPhone Ultra 預計將唔配備 Face ID，反而據報會將 Touch ID 設於側邊按鈕上。這將會係自 2017 年 Face ID 首次喺 iPhone X 登場以來，Apple 首款冇 Face ID 嘅 iPhone。', 'target': 'The iPhone Ultra is not expected to feature Face ID. Instead, it reportedly will feature Touch ID in the side button. This would be the first iPhone from Apple without Face ID since Face ID debuted on the iPhone X in 2017.'}

{'text': '至於 iPhone Ultra，Apple 好可能因為裝置嘅超薄設計而揀咗 Touch ID 而唔係 Face ID。此外，Apple 仲需要兩套 Face ID 組件：一套用於外屏幕，另一套用於內屏幕。', 'target': "As for the iPhone Ultra, Apple likely opted for Touch ID over Face ID due to the device's ultra-thin design. Additionally, Apple would need two sets of Face ID components: one for the outer display and another for the inner display."}

{'text': 'Apple 喺大多數 iPad 上，包括基本型號 iPad、iPad mini 同 iPad Air，仍然喺電源按鈕上使用 Touch ID。', 'target': 'Apple uses Touch ID in the power button on most of its iPads, including the base iPad, iPad mini, and iPad Air.'}

{'text': '#4：MagSafe', 'target': '#4: MagSafe'}

{'text': '雖然 Apple 可能會畀到我哋驚喜，但睇嚟 iPhone Ultra 將唔支援 MagSafe 無線充電。流出嘅 iPhone Ultra 模型機背部並冇顯示 MagSafe 磁吸環。', 'target': "While Apple could surprise us, it looks like the iPhone Ultra won't support MagSafe wireless charging. Leaked iPhone Ultra dummy units don't show the MagSafe magnetic ring on the back."}

{'text': 'iPhone Ultra 可能會好似 Samsung 嘅 Galaxy Z Fold 8 一樣，提供標準無線充電。不過，根據目前嘅傳聞，MagSafe 似乎好大機會缺席。', 'target': "The iPhone Ultra may offer standard wireless charging like Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8. However, based on current rumors, MagSafe appears likely to be absent."}

{'text': '#5：實體 SIM 卡', 'target': '#5: Physical SIM Card'}

{'text': '據郭明錤同 Bloomberg 等消息來源指，iPhone Ultra 將會喺全球各地僅支援 eSIM。', 'target': 'According to sources like Ming-Chi Kuo and Bloomberg, the iPhone Ultra will be eSIM-only worldwide.'}

{'text': '這好可能係因為可摺疊 iPhone 嘅超薄設計。iPhone Air 同樣極之纖薄，並喺全球各地僅支援 eSIM。至於 iPhone 17 同 iPhone 17 Pro，則係喺美國同部分其他國家僅支援 eSIM，而喺其他市場，例如中國，裝置仍然保留實體 SIM 卡槽。', 'target': 'This is likely due to the ultra-thin design of the foldable iPhone. The iPhone Air is also extremely thin and is eSIM-only worldwide. As for the iPhone 17 and iPhone 17 Pro, they are eSIM-only in the U.S. and a few other countries, while in other markets like China, the devices still retain physical SIM card slots.'}

{'text': '總結', 'target': 'Wrap Up'}

{'text': '好明顯，Apple 嘅可摺疊 iPhone Ultra 將會有多項重大取捨。問題在於，創新嘅摺疊設計所帶來嘅實用性，能否足以彌補呢啲其他限制。', 'target': "It's clear that Apple's foldable iPhone Ultra will come with several significant trade-offs. The question is whether the utility of the innovative folding design will be enough to make up for these other limitations."}

{'text': '就我個人嚟講，我好期待試用 iPhone Ultra。最令我擔心嘅取捨係缺少 MagSafe。我而家用緊 iPhone Air，所以已經習慣冇遠攝鏡頭嘅生活。我覺得自己應該可以好快適應 Touch ID。不過，我周圍都擺滿咗 MagSafe 充電器，所以要轉返普通無線充電或者長期使用有線充電將會係個大轉變。', 'target': "Personally, I'm really looking forward to trying out the iPhone Ultra. The trade-off that concerns me the most is the lack of MagSafe. I'm currently using an iPhone Air, so I've already gotten used to life without a telephoto camera. I feel like I'll be able to adapt to Touch ID fairly quickly. However, I've got MagSafe chargers stationed all over my home, so switching back to standard wireless charging or using wired charging long-term is going to be a big transition."}
